_comment: Curated corrections for facts a document does not state, or states wrongly. Keys are spec keys (filename stem without revision suffix), current or former. Allowed fields: title, workgroup, status (final|implementers|draft), note, renamed_to (merge a spec renamed without a redirect stub into its successor). Remove an entry once the source is fixed and republished; reports/source-fixes.md lists what still needs fixing.

fapi-2_0-baseline.note: FAPI 2.0 Baseline Profile 00, 01 and ID1 state workgroup "connect" — a template error. FAPI 2.0 was developed in the FAPI WG.
